name: 26-231MR Queensland property developer sentenced to 9 years imprisonment for fraud
metaDescription: Former Queensland property developer, Ian Omar Chester has been sentenced to 9 years imprisonment for aggregated fraud following an ASIC investigation into multiple Southeast Queensland property development companies.

name: 26-230MR Former Big Un CEO Richard Evans sentenced for communicating inside information
metaDescription: Richard Evans (also known as Richard Evertz), the former chief executive officer of collapsed ASX-listed technology company Big Un Limited (Big Un), has today been convicted and sentenced in the District Court of New South Wales for communicating inside information to another person.

name: 24-274MR Kraken crypto exchange operator to pay $8 million following ASIC enforcement action
metaDescription: Legal proceedings launched by ASIC have seen the Australian operator of the Kraken crypto exchange ordered to pay $8 million for unlawfully issuing a credit facility to more than 1100 Australian customers.
